content.user_title: Generate Reliable Dart FFI Bindings with FFIgen
content.value_statement: Manual Dart FFI bindings are error-prone and difficult to maintain. This skill guides agents to configure FFIgen, generate bindings, and verify outputs.
actual_capabilities: Plans programmatic FFIgen configuration for C, Objective-C, or Swift headers.
Creates a tool/ffigen.dart generator with package-relative input and output paths.
Applies precise function and header inclusion filters.
Configures generated binding files and recorded-use mapping outputs.
Adds license notices and analyzer suppressions through the generated preamble.
Runs binding generation and verifies the package with dart analyze.
limitations: Requires accessible native headers and a compatible libclang environment.
Does not repair defects in FFIgen or unsupported native declarations.
Does not validate native library behavior at runtime.
Uses project conventions that may require adjustment outside Dart repository layouts.

use_cases.title: Create First Bindings
use_cases.description: Generate focused Dart bindings from an existing C header and place outputs in the package structure.

use_cases.title: Replace Manual FFI
use_cases.description: Convert handwritten lookups and typedefs into a repeatable FFIgen workflow with generated metadata.

use_cases.title: Standardize Native Integration
use_cases.description: Review generator configuration, licensing, filters, output paths, and analyzer results across a repository.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Basic C Bindings
prompt_templates.prompt: Create FFIgen bindings for [header path], include [symbols], and place generated files under [output directory].
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one C header and a short symbol list.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Package Generator
prompt_templates.prompt: Add tool/ffigen.dart for [package], resolve paths from Platform.script, preserve [license], and verify with dart analyze.
prompt_templates.scenario: A package needs repeatable generation from any working directory.

prompt_templates.title: Replace Manual Bindings
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the existing manual Dart FFI bindings, derive precise FFIgen filters, generate replacements, and report compatibility concerns.
prompt_templates.scenario: A maintainer is removing handwritten lookups and typedefs.

prompt_templates.title: Design Advanced Native Bindings
prompt_templates.prompt: Design FFIgen configuration for [native API], including transitive headers, compiler options, leaf functions, recorded usage, licensing, and analyzer verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced integration needs controlled generation and tree-shaking metadata.

output_examples.input: Generate bindings for sqlite3_libversion from third_party/sqlite/sqlite3.h.
output_examples.output: A generator plan with one symbol filter, package-relative paths, licensed generated output, recorded-use metadata, and analyzer verification.

output_examples.input: Replace handwritten dynamic library lookups in a Dart package.
output_examples.output: A migration summary identifying native headers, generated targets, required filters, removed manual bindings, and remaining runtime validation.

output_examples.input: Review an existing FFIgen setup for repository compliance.
output_examples.output: A concise review covering dependency setup, file locations, preamble licensing, symbol scope, generation commands, and analyzer results.

best_practices: Use narrow positive filters for headers and native declarations.
Resolve generator paths from Platform.script so execution is independent of the current directory.
Regenerate outputs and run dart analyze before completing the task.
anti_patterns: Do not handwrite bindings when suitable native headers are available.
Do not edit generated files to hide compilation errors.
Do not generate an entire native API when only selected symbols are required.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It guides an agent to create a Dart FFIgen script and generated binding outputs from native headers.

faq.question: Which native languages are supported?
faq.answer: FFIgen primarily handles C headers and can support Objective-C or Swift interoperability where its configuration permits.

faq.question: Does it write manual dart:ffi bindings?
faq.answer: No. It recommends generated bindings whenever suitable native headers exist.

faq.question: Where should the generator live?
faq.answer: The documented convention places it at tool/ffigen.dart in the target package.

faq.question: How are generated files verified?
faq.answer: The workflow runs the generator, reviews changed outputs, and executes dart analyze in the target package.

faq.question: What happens when generated code has errors?
faq.answer: The skill reports compiler errors instead of editing generated files and directs maintainers to the relevant upstream issue tracker.
